Works with / Claude Code

Skills for Claude Code: free and tested

How our skills run in Claude Code, and where to start.

Claude Code reads skills from ~/.claude/skills/ for all your projects and .claude/skills/ for one project, per its docs. Copy a skill's folder there, or run npx skills add proskillpacks/skills -a claude-code, then ask for the job in plain words.

Step-by-step install page for Claude Code, with the official docs it comes from.

Tested on

Our release tests ran on Claude Sonnet, and on Claude Opus for some skills; each skill page says what it was tested on. We do not claim a separate test in Claude Code. The skills are plain files in the open SKILL.md format, so any assistant that reads that format should be able to load them, but we have not verified each tool. How we test.
